# What do App Store and Google Play server notifications mean?

Each page below answers one store notification in a sentence, then gives what triggers it, what your server should do, an example you can run and how RevenueDot applies it (38 pages). The events RevenueDot then sends to your own webhook are in [which webhook events RevenueDot sends](../../api/webhook-events.md).
